- International (English) - Deutschland - España  - International (English) - Deutschland - España Client Director THNK designs and delivers leadership journeys and transformation programmes for organisations worldwide, from ASML to the World Economic Forum. With THNK World, its own platform that enables transformation at scale, and growing demand, the company expects a major acceleration in growth. The Client Director takes ownership of programmes and helps build an organisation that continuously reinvents its field.  Amsterdam  27 okt 2026 THNK  About THNK School of Leadership THNK School of Leadership was founded some fifteen years ago out of the realisation that the world faces major challenges, and that leadership can and must be a lever to set change in motion. Today, the organisation works for companies in both the new and the established economy, as well as for a range of non-profit organisations. Clients include SAP, ASML, Siemens Energy, Johnson & Johnson, DSM-Firmenich, Siemens Mobility, Patagonia, KWF and the government of the United Arab Emirates. Every engagement starts with a consulting question: together with the board, THNK maps out where the client wants to go and what leadership is needed to get there. This is followed by a fully tailor-made programme, and THNK remains alongside the board as a partner throughout. Alongside leadership programmes for the top of organisations, THNK increasingly delivers transformation programmes around a new strategy, merger, carve-out or other structural change.
